entries.text: A depiction of a *sword* with a curved blade. When used as an element in dual-element characters, 刀 more often refers to a knife or cutting implement than to a sword.
兵也。象形。凡刀之屬皆从刀。
刀 sword/knife + a diagonal mark# emphasizing the flexible *blade* → *edge*. In 扨 and 靱, 刃 takes the form 刄, while in 牣, 訒 and 軔 it takes yet another form.
刀堅也。象刀有刃之形。凡刃之屬皆从刃。
傷也。从刃从一。

八# split right and left + 刀 sword/knife → split/*divide* an object, causing it to spread → *branch/split off*; *separate*; *portion*; *share*; *minute*; *counter* (for portions of a whole); *responsibility* (matching one's position) → *distinction*; *know*; *understand* (← know and distinguish through division) → *turn out/prove to be*.
別也。从八从刀，刀以分別物也。

As per 七# (cut) + 刀 sword/knife → *cut* neatly into small pieces → *chop*; *break*; *snap* → *break off* → *stop*; *pause*; *place to stop/leave off doing*; *turn off*; *be out of*; *run out of*; *be short of* → *expire*; *end* (of a matter); *wear out*; *wear off*; *limit*. Also, *a piece*, *a slice* and *piece of cloth*, as well as *sell below cost* and *drain* (off). *Severe*, *serious*, *urge* and *work (on)* are from the "keen" and "sharp" elements in cutting.
刌也。从刀七聲。
As per 乂# (vegetation cut in swaths) + 刀 sword/knife → *cut/reap* with a sickle or other bladed implement → *trim*; *prune*.
劃傷也。从刀气聲。一曰斷也。又讀若㱯。一曰刀不利，於瓦石上刏之。
As per 干# (press against) + 刀 sword/knife → press with a bladed implement in shaving or engraving → *shave*; *engrave* → *publish* (← arrange wooden slats by length, trimming the edges).
剟也。从刀干聲。
切也。从刀寸聲。
As per 勿# (obscure) + 刀 sword/knife → *die by the sword* (becoming obscure in death) → *die* (by having one's jugular cut); *behead* (← cut off the entire head ← slit the throat).
剄也。从刀勿聲。

The relevant oracle bone form of 开# is a depiction of handcuffs stretching about a prisoner's wrists, framing them in punishment. A bronzeware inscription form curves the vertical strokes. 刑 adds 刀 sword/knife → *punish* (by confinement, severing of body parts or by other means).
剄也。从刀幵聲。
As per 元# (round) + 刀 sword/knife → *shave/trim* into a round(ed) shape.
剸也。从刀元聲。一曰齊也。
As per 月# (scoop out/away) + 刀 sword/knife → scoop away (= cut off) feet in the punishment of amputation → *amputation of feet/legs in punishment*.
絕也。从刀月聲。
歹# severed bone/death + 刀 sword/knife → sever bones and arrange them in a row → *row* → *companion*; *attend*; *lots of*.
分解也。从刀𡿪聲。
擊也。从刀弗聲。

As per 刀 (cutting implement) + 衣 clothing → *begin* making a garment by cutting cloth (compare 裁) → *beginning* → *first*; *first time*; *naïve*. The pronunciation of the character has been influenced by 裁 (also meaning "cut cloth").
始也。从刀从衣。裁衣之始也。
As per 半# (split) + 刀 sword/knife → judgment likened to a decisive cutting in two (compare 斷, 裁, 決 and 折) → *judge* → *seal* (of judgment); *size* (← seal of a particular size).
分也。从刀半聲。

叧 as described in 拐 (sever/separate) here a variant of 歹* severed bone + 刀 sword/knife → separate flesh from bone by cutting → *separate*; *other*; *divide*; *distinguish*; *different*; *parting* → *farewell*.

禾 here an abbreviated form# of 季 season (→ season when soil is plowed) + 刀 sword/knife → sharp-edged plow → *work* (well/skillfully); *sharp*; *convenience*; *profit*; *advantage*; *be able to*; *be effective* (← sharp, effective implement).
銛也。从刀。和然後利，从和省。《易》曰：“利者，義之和也。”
As per 冊# (inscribed bamboo slats) + 刀 sword/knife → *delete* portions of records written on bamboo slats by cutting them away → *cut (away/down/out); *edit*.
剟也。从刀、冊。冊，書也。

別.explanation: Traditional rendering for the ordinary “other; different; separate” senses.
別.evidenceScope: OpenCC 1.4.2 explicitly maps 别人 to 別人; other lexical contexts require independent checking.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

彆.explanation: Traditional rendering in awkward/stubborn/twisted senses; contrasts with ordinary 別 (“other”).
彆.evidenceScope: OpenCC 1.4.2 explicitly maps 别扭 to 彆扭; not a general substitute for 别.

sources.basis: Lexical example explicitly found in OpenCC 1.4.2 STPhrases

entries.text: As per 舌# (chisel-like implement in motion) + 刀 sword/knife → scrape at with a bladed implement (compare 歳) → *scrape*; *shave* → *tear off*.
掊把也。从刀𠯑聲。
As per 刀# (curve) + 至 arrive → arrive via a route that traces an arc → *arrive at*; *reach*.
至也。从至刀聲。
As per 井# (deep) + 刅 as described in 梁 (double-edged sword) → cut deeply in wounding → *wound* → *commence/begin* (← commence an operation by cutting).
造法刱業也。从井刅聲。讀若創。
刺也。从刀圭聲。《易》曰：“士刲羊。”
As per 夸# (U-shaped) + 刀 sword/knife → *scoop out* in a U-shape → *gouge*; *bore*; *hollow out*; *excavate*.
判也。从刀夸聲。
斷耳也。从刀从耳。

To a variant of 木 tree/wood, the left-hand element# adds 丿 (split) → split off part of a branch. 制 adds 刀 sword/knife → cut to *control* the growth of a tree → *arrange into shape* → *regulation*; *system*; *establish*.
裁也。从刀从未。未，物成有滋味，可裁斷。一曰止也。

The left-hand element# is a variant of 屈 (bend). 刷 adds 刀 sword/knife → bend in scraping (compare 祭) → *scrape away impurities* → *rub*; *clean* (← compare 擦) → *print* (← rub paper on a woodblock with a brush).
刮也。从刀，㕞省聲。《禮》：“布刷巾。”

The relevant seal inscription form of 𠔉# shows the palm of an open hand (symbolizing a handprint as a guarantee) + 廾 pair of hands (suggesting the parties involved in a transaction) → wooden slat on which handprints were made as a guarantee. As proof of a transaction, this slat was cut in two, each piece wrapped/rolled up with an encircling cord, and one piece given to each of the two parties involved. 券 adds 刀 sword/knife (for emphasis/clarification) → cut slats serving as proof of a transaction into two pieces → *draft*; *certificate*; *ticket*.
契也。从刀𢍏聲。券別之書，以刀判契其旁，故曰契券。

Originally a variant of 殺, with 刀 sword/knife in place of 殳 action indicator. 刹 came to be used primarily for transliterations of Buddhist terminology, such as 刹那 (Sanskrit: ksana), an instant. *Temple* and *monastery* (example: 禅刹) are therefore borrowed meanings.
柱也。从刀，未詳。殺省聲。
As per 朿# (stab) + 刀 sword/knife → *stab*; *stick*; *pierce*; *prick*; *sting*.
君殺大夫曰刺。刺，直傷也。从刀从朿，朿亦聲。
As per 亥# (stretched taut) + 刀 sword/knife → *cut/chop* at a taut object → *notch*; *carve*; *engrave*.
鏤也。从刀亥聲。
As per 弟# (vertical alignment) + 刀 sword/knife → *shave* up and down.
巠 here an abbreviated form# of 頸 throat + 刀 sword/knife → *slit a throat*.
刑也。从刀坙聲。

The relevant seal inscription form is an abbreviated form# of 鼎 tripod kettle/cauldron + a knife beside it for cutting food or other objects (compare 析). *Rule* and *law* are abstract, extended meanings (← abide by/*follow* norms closely ← be beside/in line with something) → *at once*; *if so*.
等畫物也。从刀从貝。貝，古之物貨也。
挑取也。从刀肙聲。一曰窐也。
As per 坐# (circular) + 刀 sword/knife → *cut/chop* finely and arrange the pieces in a circle.
折傷也。从刀坐聲。
As per 肖# (resemble in miniature) + 刀 sword/knife → shave, scrape, plane or pare, creating small likenesses of the original object → *shave/plane/pare*; *reduce*; *remove*; *erase*; *cut*; *delete*.
鞞也。一曰析也。从刀肖聲。
克# overcome + 刀 sword/knife → *overcome*/*vanquish* enemies by cutting them down → *win*.

剋.explanation: The standard lists the relationship but explicitly does not simplify 剋 pronounced kēi when it means scolding or hitting. 克 also remains unchanged in ordinary words meaning overcome/gram.
剋.example: 克服 → 克服; 剋人 (kēi, scold/hit) remains 剋
剋.unchangedSense: 克服 and inherited uses of 克; 剋 read kēi for scolding/hitting
剋.evidenceScope: Targeted review of individual relationships against 2013 通用规范汉字表 Appendix 1; not a comprehensive audit of every Unihan pair.

entries.text: A variant of 利 sharp → slash with a sharp weapon → *be in opposition* → *turn one's back on*. Also, *leap/jump about* (← leap/jump about in slashing at).
戾也。从束从刀。刀者，剌之也。

The relevant seal inscription form of the element# minus 刀 combines an abbreviated form of 船 boat + 止 (leg/foot) → progression of boats or of people on foot. The addition of 刀 sword/knife suggests the idea of cutting/shearing in small increments → *forward progress* in small increments (compare 先 and 踐) → *before*; *in front* (← immediately behind/in front of one). In derivative characters, 前 is often written in the form seen for example in 揃 and 湔.
不行而進謂之歬。从止在舟上。
As per 易# (stretch flat) + 刀 sword/knife → *cut/scrape* in flattening an object → *scoop/gouge out*.
解骨也。从刀易聲。
As per 咅# (spread) + 刀 sword/knife → object that spreads in being split/divided in two → *split* (in two); *divide*.
判也。从刀咅聲。
As per 戔# (fine/slight) + 刀 sword/knife → *trim/pare* finely.
As per 岡# (hard rope/cable) + 刀 sword/knife → cutting implement able to slice through a *strong* or *hard* object such as rope or cable.
彊斷也。从刀岡聲。
削也。从刀宛聲。

As per 彔# (pare/strip) + 刀 sword/knife → *pare*; *strip (off)*; *peel*; *come/peel off*; *shell* (a nut). 剝 was devised to replace 彔 after the latter came to be associated specifically with carving.祿 (13)　ロクAs per 彔# (scatter right and left) + 示 altar/the supernatural → blessings scattered on humans by the gods → *happiness*; *prosperity* → *salary*. 禄 is a variant form that is sometimes encountered.
裂也。从刀从录。录，刻割也。录亦聲。
As per 奇# (lean) + 刀 sword/knife → *carving/engraving knife* (← tool held at an angle when carving) → *carve*; *engrave*.
剞𠜾，曲刀也。从刀奇聲。
刊也。从刀叕聲。
As per 炎# (consuming blaze) + 刀 sword/knife → temper a blade → *sharpen* → *sharp-pointed*; *sharp*; *shave*.
銳利也。从刀炎聲。
乘# multiply + 刀 sword/knife → cut off a *surplus*, multiplying the number of pieces and leaving a *remainder*.

As per 前# (cut/shear in small increments) + 刀 sword/knife → shears used to *cut* closely → *clip*; *shear*; *trim*. 剪, like 揃, was devised to replace 前 after the latter underwent its transformation of meanings.
齊斷也。从刀歬聲。
判也。从刀度聲。
斷齊也。从刀耑聲。
咼# (variant of 冎 bone) + 刀 sword/knife. Effectively, 剮 is a variant of 叧 as described in 拐 (sever/separate a limb from its joint) → *cut*.

The relevant oracle bone form of 畐# is a depiction of an alcohol container with a bulging middle and of abundant capacity (compare 腹). 副 adds 刀 sword/knife → cut/divide abundant contents into half → *halve* → *assist* (← assist by cutting/dividing) → *complement*; *supplement*; *accompany*; *duplicate*; *secondary*; *assistant*; *vice-*.
判也。从刀畐聲。《周禮》曰：“副辜祭。”

As per 害# (cut) + 刀 sword/knife → sharp implement used in cutting/separating → *separation*; *division*; *breakage* → *cut*; *split*; *divide*; *break*; *crack open*; *dilute*; *drop below* (a standard) → *rate*; *ratio*; *percentage*; *allocation*; *comparatively*. Also, *find out* (← figuratively crack open a criminal's hiding place).
剥也。从刀害聲。
荅# (press/fit together) + 刀 sword/knife → use a sharp-edged instrument to *pin down/together* official records or other objects.
As per 豈# (pile) + 刀 sword/knife → create a pile of shavings in carefully sharpening a blade → *sharpen* → *apply to*; *cut*.
大鎌也。一曰摩也。从刀豈聲。
As per 倉# (pile) + 刀 sword/knife → start on woodworking, creating a pile of shavings (compare 乍) → *start upon* → *create*.
As per 專# (round and/or rotating object) + 刀 sword/knife → *cut*/*slash* a round/lumpy object from top to bottom.
剥也。劃也。从刀𠩺聲。
As per 票# (light) + 刀 sword/knife → lightly/deftly strip away with a bladed instrument → *snatch*; *plunder*; *steal*. Also, → *threaten*.
砭刺也。从刀𤐫聲。一曰剽，劫人也。
巣# nest + 刀 sword/knife → destructive actions of a nest of cut-throat outlaws → *destroy*; *cut off* → *cut*. 剿 and 勦 are effectively variant forms; compare the replacement of 刀 by 力 in 劇.
刮去惡創肉也。从刀矞聲。《周禮》曰：“劀殺之齊。”
畫# demarcate/mark off + 刀 sword/knife → *demarcate*/*mark off* with a bladed implement → *divide*.
錐刀曰劃。从刀从畫，畫亦聲。

豦 is 虍 tiger + 豕 pig/boar → boar likened to a tiger in ferocity. A scribal form character combines 豦# + 力 power/energy → *fierce*/swift activity → *severe*; *rapid*. *Drama* and (theatrical) *play* are borrowed meanings. 力 eventually came to be written 刀.
尤甚也。从刀，未詳。豦聲。
As per 辟# (spread severed body parts) + 刀 sword/knife → *slash*/*cleave* → *rip*; *tear*; *break* → *ear-splitting sound*.
破也。从刀辟聲。

𨥫# combines 金 metal + a variant of 卯 (bend). The original signification of this character is obscure, but likely similar to that of 戮 (kill). 劉 adds 刀 sword/knife → force a victim to bend/hang the neck then decapitate with a bladed implement → *kill*.
斷也。从刀會聲。
絕也。从刀喿聲。《周書》曰：“天用劋絕其命。”
利傷也。从刀歲聲。
As per 僉# (assemble) + 刀 knife/sword → assemblage of blades in a double-bladed *sword*. The numerous variant forms include 剱, 釼, 劒 and 劔.
As per 齊# (align) + 刀 sword/knife → align cut pieces of bark and plant roots for medicinal use → *medicine*; *drug*.
齊也。从刀从齊，齊亦聲。
人所帶兵也。从刃僉聲。
鼻# nose + 刀 sword/knife → *slice off a person's nose* in punishment. Compare 罪.
斷也。从刀毚聲。一曰剽也，釗也。
A depiction of the rippling muscles of a powerful arm → *power*; *energy* → *strength*; *skill*; *ability*; *labor*; *make efforts*.
筋也。象人筋之形。治功曰力，能圉大災。凡力之屬皆从力。
工# work + 力 power/energy → accomplish a job/piece of work → *achievement*; *merit*; *fruits*; *good deed*.
以勞定國也。从力从工，工亦聲。

A variant of 可 (bend/cup a hand about the mouth to amplify the voice in shouting), with *add*, *append* and *increase* being associated meanings (← add a hand atop the mouth to increase the volume of one's voice). Also, *join* (in) and *inflict* (← join in something inflicting damage/injury).
語相增加也。从力从口。
力 here an abbreviated form# of 勵 exert + 少 (small/slight) → make but a slight/*weak* exertion → *inferiority*.
弱也。从力少聲。
同力也。从三力。《山海經》曰：“惟號之山，其風若劦。”凡劦之屬皆从劦。
As per 且# (pile) + 力 power/energy → supplementary power that assists in piling → *help*; *assistance* → *save*; *rescue*.
左也。从力且聲。
As per 奴# (strenuous activity) + 力 power/energy → *strive*/make great exertions → *exert oneself*.
去# withdraw + 力 power/energy → *coerce* others into withdrawing. *Long period of time* derives from the compound 劫波, a transliteration of the Sanskrit kalpa.
人欲去，以力脅止曰劫。或曰以力止去曰劫。
As per 句# (bend) + 力 power/energy → *bend down/over* (curving the back) in working (compare 傴) → *become fatigued*.
勞也。从力句聲。

召 here an abbreviated form# of 超 exceed + 力 power/energy → *encourage* someone to exceed current standards or limits → *diligent* (← make an exceedingly great effort). Also, *beautiful* (← fine results of effort; compare 功).
勉也。从力召聲。讀若舜樂《韶》。
勞也。从力，卷省聲。
As per 交# (twist/cross) + 力 power/energy → crossing of energy back and forth in effective cooperation → *work well*; *effect*; *do one's best*. *Take after* is a borrowed meaning via 效.
As per 吉# (reduce/eliminate space) + 力 power/energy → firmly and carefully fill or compact an object (compare 拮) → *firm*; *careful* → *discreet*.
愼也。从力吉聲。《周書》曰：“汝劼毖殷獻臣。”
As per 亥# (stretched taut) + 力 power/energy → stretch a slack object, making it taut → (criminal) *investigation* (← tighten a loose collection of facts and bring to a conclusion).
法有辠也。从力亥聲。
尤極也。从力𠑽聲。
As per 巠# as described in 徑 (extensive) + 力 power/energy → extensive, long-lasting *strength* → *strong*; *tough*. Compare 勍.
彊也。从力巠聲。
孛# spring up + 力 power/energy → *sudden* action, in the form of springing up or bursting forth.
排也。从力孛聲。

The relevant bronzeware inscription form is 柬 here an abbreviated form of 諫 admonish + 攵# (strike) → admonish by striking. A seal inscription form is 敕 as described in 整 (pull tightly on a bundle in straightening it) → admonish → *imperial edict* (issued to keep retainers/subjects in line; compare 詔). 勅 is a variant of 敕 that has relegated 敕 to variant form status.
An abbreviated form# of 甬 (run through) + 力 power/energy → stamp the ground energetically, as though to run through it → *spirited*; *lively* → *brave*; *courageous*.
气也。从力甬聲。
As per 免# (draw out of/away from) + 力 power/energy → *make great efforts* in drawing out of or away from (compare 敏 and 僶) → *encourage*.
彊也。从力免聲。
京 here an abbreviated form# of 鯨 whale (→ powerful creature) + 力 power/energy → *strong*. For the meaning "strong," compare 強 and 勁.
彊也。《春秋傳》曰：“勍敵之人。”从力京聲。
As per 來# (fruit of grain) + 力 power/energy → *reward* (likened to the fruit of effort). For the idea of fruit in a figurative sense, compare 果.
勞也。从力來聲。
As per 力# (ripples) + 革 leather → the rippling straps of an (equestrian) *halter* → *restrain*; *suppress*; *control*; *regulate*.
馬頭絡銜也。从革力聲。

As per 重# (run through) + 力 power/energy → strenuous *work* involving the running through of objects (compare 用 and 同) → *movement* → *go/put into action*, *shift*; *transfer*; *change*; *operate* (a machine); *run* (a machine/an enterprise); *developments*; *activities*.
作也。从力重聲。
As per 冐/冒# (wrap about) + 力 power/energy → *work hard/diligently* in wrapping something.
勉也。《周書》曰：“勖哉，夫子！”从力冒聲。
甚# extreme + 力 power/energy → penetrate deeply in considering/investigating → *consider thoroughly*; *perception*; *intuition* (← profound insight). Compare 含 and 念.
校也。从力甚聲。
敄# is 矛 pike/halberd + 攵 (strike) → great exertion in battle. 務 adds 力 power/energy (for emphasis/clarification) → *work*; *serve*; *carry out one's duties*.
趣也。从力敄聲。
As per 朕# (rise) + 力 power/energy → rise above in superiority → *be superior to*; *be predominant*; *excel* → *victory*; *win*; *defeat* (v.).
任也。从力朕聲。
As per 𤇾# as described in 榮 (curve) + 力 power/energy → bend/stoop in *labor* and/or *fatigue* (compare 留) → *work hard*; *hard work*.
劇也。从力，熒省。熒，火燒冂，用力者勞。
As per 莫# (concealed) + 力 power/energy → strive to obtain something concealed, or not at hand → *appeal* (for/to); *invite*; *recruit*; *raise* (money) → *grow intense*.
廣求也。从力莫聲。
As per 翏# (separate from a main unit) + 力 power/energy → *combine/unite forces* (once separate).
并力也。从力翏聲。
劫也。从力㶾聲。
As per 埶# (cut) + 力 power/energy → cut (something tall/long) energetically → *force*; *power*; *energy*.
盛力權也。从力埶聲。經典通用埶。
As per 責# (pile) + 力 power/energy → *meritorious deed*; *achievements*; *exploits* (← figurative pile of deeds/achievements). For the conceptual link between achievements and a pile, compare 績.
As per 𦰩# as described in 漢 (stretch over a fire) + 力 power/energy → *work diligently*; *industrious* → *employment*. Also, *be fit for/equal to* (a task).
勞也。从力𡏳聲。
迫也。从力强聲。
巣# nest + 力 power/energy → destructive actions of a nest of cut-throat outlaws → *seize*; *steal*; *destroy*; *kill*. 勦 and 剿 are effectively variant forms; compare the replacement of 刀 by 力 in 劇.
勞也。《春秋傳》曰：“安用勦民？”从力巢聲。
繇緩也。从力象聲。
勞也。《詩》曰：“莫知我勩。”从力貰聲。
務也。从力豦聲。
As per 劦# as described in 協 (harmonious cooperation) + 思 (fine) → a fine and *harmonious* meeting of the minds (compare 洽) → *peaceful*.
勉力也。《周書》曰：“用勱相我邦家。”讀若萬。从力萬聲。
熏 here an abbreviated form# of 薰 fragrance + 力 power/energy → the (figuratively) fragrant result of effort → *merit*.
能成王功也。从力熏聲。
厲# (vigorous exertion) + 力 power/energy → *urge* others to *exert* themselves/*work hard* → *apply oneself to*; *be diligent* → *encourage*; *cheer up*; *raise the voice*; *incentive*; *stimulation*.
發也。从力从徹，徹亦聲。

雚# is 艸 grass/plant + an element combining 口 mouth (doubled) and 隹 squat bird → flock of birds above a marsh, in circular uniformity. 勸 adds 力 power/energy → offer a uniform recommendation/suggestion etc. → *recommend* *suggest*; *advise*; *encourage*; *offer*.
勉也。从力雚聲。
An abbreviated form of 包 envelop → *wrap*.
裹也。象人曲形，有所包裹。凡勹之屬皆从勹。

A depiction of a slightly curved *spoon* or *ladle* + a stroke representing the contents of a container rising and becoming evident → *unit of capacity* (approximately 0.018 liters); *unit of area* (approximately 0.033 square meters).
挹取也。象形，中有實，與包同意。凡勺之屬皆从勺。
少也。从勹、二。
聚也。从勹九聲。讀若鳩。
覆也。从勹覆人。
A variant of 句 (bend): *bend*. *Hook* and *capture* are borrowed meanings.
A depiction of curved pieces of cloth dimly visible in the liquid in which they are being soaked → *negation* (← negativity likened to darkness ) → *prohibition*.
州里所建旗。象其柄，有三游。雜帛，幅半異。所以趣民，故遽，稱勿勿。凡勿之屬皆从勿。
